result.paraphrase: Gigabyte Radeon RX 5700XT Gaming OC 8G Navi graphics card. Key features: powered by AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT, equipped with 8GB GDDR6 and a 256-bit memory interface, WINDFORCE 3X cooling with alternate spinning fans, RGB Fusion 2.0 for syncing with other AORUS devices, and a metal back plate. The WINDFORCE 3X cooling system uses three 80mm unique blade fans, alternate spinning fan design, five composite copper heat pipes, heat-pipe direct touch, and 3D active fan functionality to deliver efficient heat dissipation for higher performance at lower temperatures. GIGABYTE’s alternate spinning design solves turbulent airflow from three fans by reversing the middle fan so airflow between the two fans moves in the same direction, reducing turbulence and increasing airflow pressure. Unique blade fans split airflow at the triangular edge and guide it smoothly through the 3D stripe curve on the fan surface to improve airflow. The 3D Active Fan provides semi-passive cooling, keeping the fans off during low-load or low-power gaming so you can play in complete silence when the system is light or idle. Pure copper heat pipes maximize direct contact with the GPU for better heat transfer, and they also cover the VRAM through a large metal plate contact for proper cooling. The composite heat pipe combines thermal conductivity and phase transition to manage heat transfer between two solid interfaces and increase cooling capacity.
